question: On which of the following days, that is celebrated as a national festival, did India become a Sovereign, Democratic and Republic state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Republic Day**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Republic Day is celebrated every year on the 26th of January.
 
• It marks the day when the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950, replacing the Government of India Act (1935) as the governing document of India.
 
• On this day, India officially became a sovereign, democratic republic, and its people chose their own government.
